messages:
maria: quick flag 1: saw spikes in token counts for a handful of tenants after we started soft v2 routing. looks like pinning + autoswitch overlap.

tomas: which tenants? any repro steps?

maria: reproducible with tenant=acme-marketing during low-token burst patterns. they were pinned to v1, a micro header flip caused autoswitch to v2 and console shows both variants being billed.

sophie: are pin TTLs and handshake debounce racing? we saw something similar months ago.

maria: yep. pin ttl is 24h, handshake debounce 5m. jitter during bursts causes transient fallback, so in the same logical session we charge both variants.

jason: current billing attribution is "served-variant" which means mid-session flips double-count. risky.

eng-platform-bot: alert: route.pin-debounce anomalies up 15% in last 4h

tomas: propose two things: (A) add a tenant-level console "escape hatch" to force unpin immediately; (B) implement a transient pin-grace state in routing (default 2m) that prevents dual billing during handshake windows.

sophie: agree. details: grace window configurable per-tenant, console must show overlap and audit trail. avoid creating loopholes for cheating.

jason: billing decision: default conservative approach = charge pre-pin stable variant unless unpin-forced audit exists. will need compliance signoff.

maria: console UX: stacked-series: pinned, fallback, overlap. action button to force-unpin and annotate timeline. also add a read-only "simulate-unpin" that shows hypothetical billing impact.

tomas: routing tasks: transient pin-grace keyed by route hash, emit events pin.grace.enter/leave, avoid counting overlap as billed during grace.

jason: telemetry: add route.pin.requested, route.pin.forced, route.pin.grace_enter, route.attribute.overlap_detected (sampled 1% globally, 100% for tenants using escape hatch).

sophie: action items: maria mock overlap UI, tomas PR for proxy grace, jason telemetry/billing spec, ops ensure sampling stable during canary.

maria: filing follow-up incident ticket with plan and root cause. will link PRs here. thanks."
